teaser: You are halfway through zipping a bag when you stop and refold everything inside it, corners square, nothing loose. That is what it looks like when a 5 and an ISTJ share one pair of hands: a love of leaving, held inside a habit of doing things right. The itch for the next place sits next to a loyalty to the last careful system that worked, and most weeks both run at once — the door half open, the coat folded anyway, the bag packed as if someone were grading it.
